title: Formalization Product Bundle (PRD node output)
description: Wave 8 package-local schema (W8-A2) for the output of the define-product-contract formalization node. Declares the WHAT-side root: PRD plus the FR/NFR/RULE family the node owns. Refs only — artifact content lives in the tracker. The kernel resolver resolve-product-contract re-reads these exact ids/hashes before the common kernel gate accepts them.

formalizationEpicId.description: The REQ-NNN episode where PRD/FR/NFR/RULE artifacts land.

discoveryCertificateRef.description: Ref to the accepted discovery certificate authorizing this formalization.

discoveryCertificateHash.description: sha256Hex of the discovery certificate for traceable lineage.

prd.description: The Product Requirements Document artifact (required, status draft/in_review until kernel-gate acceptance).

functionalRequirements.description: FR artifacts hanging off the PRD. At least one is required so UC/AC can trace back to a stable handle.

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Optional NFR artifacts hanging off the PRD.

businessRules.description: Optional RULE artifacts with explicit enforcement trace.

code.description: Stable queryable code, e.g. 'PRD', 'FR-3', or null.

path.description: Repository-relative path. Must NOT be absolute (no leading slash or drive letter).

status.description: Worker creates candidates only; kernel-gate accepts. 'accepted' never appears in worker output.

acceptedHash.description: sha256Hex read back from Saga, not remembered.
